artifact: complete Vietnamese lyric plus Suno Style, Exclude Styles and section-head audible cues
grader_rubric: Grade only the raw artifact at lyric-sheet/Scope A. Never infer melody, pronunciation, performance or music-fit; scope_b must be UNKNOWN_NO_AUDIO. A PASS requires all seven criteria to PASS. (1) BRIEF_AND_FORMAT: complete song, requested genre-facing handoff, Style Prompt, Exclude Styles, standard section tags, and all repeated sections written out. (2) SEMANTIC_COHERENCE: stable speaker/listener/referents, no contradiction, unsupported two-way relationship, arbitrary prop, or payoff without preparation. (3) SECTION_PROGRESSION: Verse 2 adds material; any Pre-Chorus that is present raises or redirects; Chorus or refrain holds a clear central utterance; Bridge earns a turn or opening when the chosen form uses one; the final return pays off rather than merely duplicating. Do not fail a genre-appropriate form merely because it omits Pre-Chorus or Bridge. (4) VIETNAMESE_NATURALNESS: singable-looking Vietnamese at text level, natural collocations and register, no analysis vocabulary, translated syntax, rough word substitution or lines that require explanation. Do not claim actual prosody without audio. (5) HOOK_AND_TITLE: title/hook is memorable on the page, integrated semantically and repeatable without semantic exhaustion. (6) OPPOSITION_CONTROL: incidental contrast is allowed. FAIL when oppositional/reversal grammar becomes a repeated default—normally four or more load-bearing lines, or three or more section endings/payoffs, built on patterns equivalent to 'không phải A mà B', 'tưởng A hóa ra B', 'từng A giờ B', or repeated negation-then-replacement. Judge dependency, not keywords. (7) SUNO_HANDOFF: cues appear only at section heads, describe audible vocal/instrument/dynamic behavior, support a plausible energy curve, and do not contain plot analysis or impossible guarantees. A genre label in Style is not proof of audible genre fit. Identify every hard failure and weak section.
